MetaData.title: Second Product Rentals
MetaData.description: A local proof page for a second product rental website powered by the same Pumpkin CMS frontend.
MetaData.author: Second Product Rentals Team

searchData.contentSummary: Second Product Rentals is a generic local proof tenant for validating a reusable Pumpkin CMS rental website engine.

content.headline: Second Product Rentals
content.subheadline: A safe local proof site showing that one frontend can serve a separate rental brand, tenant, theme, sitemap, and contact workflow from Pumpkin CMS.

items.title: Shared Frontend
items.text: One app resolves the site from the request host

items.title: Separate Tenant
items.text: CMS content is partitioned by tenantId

items.title: Separate Theme
items.text: Brand styling can differ per tenant

items.title: Repeatable Seed
items.text: Local proof data can be recreated safely

content.title: What this proof validates
content.subtitle: The content is intentionally generic so the second-site mechanics can be tested before production copy is written.

cards.title: Tenant routing
cards.description: The second host should resolve to the second tenant and fetch its own CMS pages.

cards.title: Independent sitemap
cards.description: Published second-site pages should appear with the second site's canonical domain.

cards.title: Contact capture
cards.description: The same contact flow can submit entries for the resolved tenant.

content.title: Second-site proof questions
content.subtitle: These notes keep the local proof clear and safe.

items.question: Is this production content?
items.answer: No. This is generic local proof content for validating multi-site routing, CMS loading, sitemap output, and contact form behavior.

items.question: Does this include real secrets?
items.answer: No. The tenant template keeps a placeholder API hash and relies on local environment variables at seed time.

items.question: Can the final second site use different copy and styling?
items.answer: Yes. The tenant, theme, page copy, SEO metadata, structured data, and contact details should be replaced before production.

content.title: Ready to test the second tenant?
content.description: Seed the second local tenant with a local-only API hash, then open the app through the second local hostname.
